metadata.description: Kevin Wong's Claude Code artifacts — agents, skills, and commands spanning web stack engineering, game design, GitHub workflow, Notion workspace publishing, GTLI content pipeline, UX persona review, JGCC educational quality auditing, and security/fuzzing tooling

plugins.name: kwong-stack-agents
plugins.description: 37 specialist agents across 9 engineering domains: Web Stack, Game Design, GitHub, Quality, Research, Product, Cross-cutting, Workspace (Notion: architect, publisher, importer, governance), and Meta. Each agent has /audit, /scaffold, and /advise. Master orchestrator routes in dependency order.

plugins.name: kwong-agents
plugins.description: 33 agents: GTLI content pipeline, UX persona reviewers, JGCC educational quality auditors, AI prompt engineer, auth auditors, and design team

plugins.name: kwong-commands
plugins.description: Slash commands for both agent sets — JGCC audit, UX review, doc audit, security baseline, compile-marketplace, stack orchestration, game/github/notion/knowledge/publish panels, sprint management, Notion publishing (setup/publish/import/audit), and project setup. Requires kwong-agents, kwong-stack-agents, or kwong-skills.

plugins.name: kwong-skills
plugins.description: 79 skills from the ernest repo covering fuzzing, security auditing, static analysis, blockchain vulnerability scanning, and development tooling
